info.title: GitStore alpha.9 typed watch transport
info.description: Source 68f8471edc947e417c98b6e8299a1367ab6b20da app/graphql.go, resolver/watch.go and per-kind schemas. GET upgrades to graphql-transport-ws. A connection_init payload Authorization Bearer value is mandatory; URL credentials are never used. Subscribe uses watchNamespaces/watchRepositories/watchProducts/watchCategories/watchFiles with optional LabelSelectorInput and opaque journal resourceVersion, plus optional namespace for namespaced kinds. Per-kind bootstrap sentinels return a high-water BOOKMARK, not an object snapshot. ADDED/MODIFIED include the typed object; DELETED/BOOKMARK omit it. Typed tombstones omit UID, so CLI ID watch remains DEP-018. Collection watch remains DEP-002. Raw server cursors are not selection-bound; client checkpoints bind installation/profile/account/kind/namespace/name/selector and require explicit matching resume. WATCH_EXPIRED requires explicit resnapshot. Duplicate delivery is allowed.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade; connection_init/connection_ack precede subscribe. JSON next/error/complete and ping/pong follow graphql-transport-ws.
